// Page-wide rules for every control on the settings page, so each one meets the touch size and shows a clear focus outline.
// Written as one string so the dialogs, which render outside the page, can wear it too.
export const CONTROLS = [
  // At least 44 by 44 for anything pressed or typed into.
  "[&_[data-slot=button]]:min-h-11!",
  "[&_[data-slot$=-trigger]]:min-h-11!",
  "[&_[data-slot=input]]:min-h-11!",
  "[&_[data-slot=input-group]]:min-h-11!",
  "[&_[data-slot=select-trigger]]:min-h-11!",
  "[&_[data-slot=toggle-group-item]]:min-h-11!",
  // A solid outline in the focus colour, on top of the soft ring the components draw.
  "[&_:focus-visible]:outline-2!",
  "[&_:focus-visible]:outline-solid!",
  "[&_:focus-visible]:outline-ring!",
].join(" ");
